posts.author: Frostorm
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Characters & Tiles
Maker Format:
MV
Art Style:
Darker/grittier version of RTP
I'm looking for more assets that follow the theme of the "Dark Fantasy" DLC content. Not only does it fit the theme and feel of my game, but the characters are also
taller
and look crisp at the same time.
I especially like the color choices used here, not too vibrant but not dull either. I am using LTBS so side view battlers aren't necessary (even tho the corresponding SV battlers for these characters look amazing). If anyone's got tileset recommendations, that would be lovely as well.
Edit: Formatting
To give a better idea of what I'm looking for...notice how the portraits of the Dark Fantasy characters are slightly muted compared to the default MV portraits. That's basically the look I'm going for.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Well, you know you can mute portraits and sprites yourself easily in programs like Gimp, right? ;3
For taller sprites I would recommend the list I made here, in the Dark Fantasy tab you can find a few additional graphics and even some modular parts that allow you to put together some more costum chars:
Stand tall - A list for tall MV Sprites
I did not want to hijack @mlogan s thread, so I made a new one, I am sorry if that causes any inconvenience, but I got several people asking where to get tall MV sprites and I felt there was a need for a list that is as complete as possible. I only state if commercial use is generally okay, for...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: Frostorm
posts.body: /facepalm...I literally forgot I could just edit the assets. That's how not-an-artist I am lol. But thank you for the epiphany!
